newsitem.title: UK: Tarmac signs contract for Copenhagen metro.
newsitem.headline: Tarmac signs contract for Copenhagen metro.

text.p: UK construction group Tarmac Plc said on Thursday that the Copenhagen Metro Construction Group (Comet), of which it is a part, is to design and build Copenhagen's first underground system following the signing of a contract for the 330 million stg project.
Comet was chosen in August as the preferred contractor and the signed contract means the consortium has finally clinched the project, which will take about four years to complete.
Comet comprises Tarmac Construction International, SAE International AUEP.PA, Astaldi SpA, Bachy Ltd, Ilbau GmbH and Christiani & Nielsen A/S. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
